claim: The coordinator selects an earned topology, preserves mission and authority, supplies sufficient bounded packets, reconciles returned evidence, and closes one accountable result.
criteria: Maps three independent read-only loci and admits bounded parallel inspection if slots exist.
Gives each worker an exact folder, retry question, evidence burden, and return contract.
Keeps cross-folder comparison and final risk synthesis with the root.
acceptable_variation: Uses fewer workers if live concurrency is smaller.
Performs one locus locally while workers inspect the others.
failure_signals: Sends every worker the whole repository without ownership.
Waits immediately while leaving useful root work idle.
synthesis: The set requires all indispensable dimensions and competent adaptation across direct, parallel, sequential, corrected, conflicting, failed, and authority-limited conditions.
